characters.summary: Sarah Kerrigan is an immensely powerful psychic and combatant who evolved into the Queen of Blades, combining psionic mastery, stealth, and overwhelming Zerg swarm tactics.
weaknesses: Xel'naga artifacts capable of cleansing or draining psionic energy
Over-reliance on the Zerg Swarm's hive mind connectivity when disconnected
limitations: Psionic power requires intense concentration or energy reserves.

sources.supports: Abilities, psionic powers, and feats of the Queen of Blades in StarCraft

feats.claim: Telepathically dominated large portions of the Zerg Swarm.

notableResults.citation: StarCraft II: Heart of the Swarm
notableResults.note: Defeated and reverted from the Queen of Blades temporarily via Xel'naga artifact.

campaignTags.claim: Can hover and fly using wings or psionic energy.
Extremely powerful psionic abilities including mind control and telekinesis.
Can utilize Psionic Shift to rapidly traverse short distances.

unknowns: Exact limits of her power ascension as a Xel'naga compared to her Queen of Blades form.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to holy magic or entities capable of banishing netherrealm spirits
limitations: Hellfire attacks rely on Netherrealm magic energy.

sources.supports: Scorpion background, hellfire abilities, and signature moves

notableResults.note: Varies by timeline, but frequently defeats Bi-Han in the Netherrealm.

campaignTags.claim: Can teleport across distances in combat.

unknowns: Exact power fluctuations between his human specter and pure wraith forms across reboots.

characters.summary: Sephiroth is a legendary elite soldier turned god-like antagonist who wields the massive Masamune blade and devastating magic spells like Supernova.
weaknesses: Psychological instability linked to his origin and Jenova's influence
limitations: Physical body is often dormant while he exerts will through clones or remnants.

sources.supports: Sephiroth abilities, sword skills, and magic use

feats.claim: Impaled and killed Aerith Gainsborough during prayer.

notableResults.note: Defeated in the Lifestream at the conclusion of the game.

campaignTags.claim: Can levitate and fly using a single black wing.
Casts high-level destruction and elemental magic.

unknowns: The full extent of his connection to the Lifestream.

weaknesses: Stationary or slow-moving due to massive monstrous bulk

mechanisms: Absolute invulnerability to physical and energy attacks

weaknesses: Time limit imposed by Chaos Emerald energy consumption
